text:
The judge should sustain the objection and exclude the deposition. It is hearsay offered to prove structural defects, and the former-testimony exception does not apply: although the engineer is unavailable and the company examined him, it lacked a similar motive in the wrongful-termination case to develop the defect testimony. It is not a party-opponent admission, because he spoke after his employment ended, and it is not a statement against his own interest.

CONFIDENCE: 78
